tools.name: get_property_information
tools.description: Public verified description, capacity and facilities of the fully privatized property near Rouen. French source text may be translated by the assistant.

tools.name: get_dog_information

Dogs welcome with no size or weight limit and no breed excluded; the dog may stay alone in the house; one dog per stay without prior approval, more agreed case by case. tools.description: Public check-in, check-out, early check-in and late check-out options, group, dog, cat, cleaning and event rules. tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: Official website, booking page and public contact. Booking and payment are completed on the official site, never inside this AI tool.

tools.name: list_carnet_articles
tools.description: Published articles from Le Carnet, the public journal of La Demeure des Dix, in French, English, German or Dutch. Read-only. Returns title, date, summary and canonical URL. Drafts are never included.

tools.name: get_carnet_article
tools.description: A published Le Carnet article in French, English, German or Dutch. Accepts a canonical slug, a translated slug, or a public URL, plus a language. Returns structured text, dates, image, illustration credit, canonical URL, and the public Markdown URL when it exists. Read-only. Drafts are not available

tools.name: list_agenda_events
tools.description: List published events around Elbeuf and Rouen (Normandy) over the next 120 days, selected and checked by La Demeure des Dix. Returns dates, place, source mention, public page URL in the same language. A session with startDate null is ongoing with an unknown start date (open until endDate). dogs_sour

tools.name: get_agenda_event
tools.description: Read one published event by its slug in a given language: full text, all upcoming sessions, place, source mention, and public URL. Read-only.
